meta.title: Cantek Diagnostics
meta.description: Cold storage diagnostics and repair guidance from Cantek manuals.

home.headline: Describe the problem. Get the procedure from Cantek manuals.
home.subhead: Find relevant guidance from authorized Cantek repair documents. Safety-critical and hazardous work must be handled by qualified personnel.
home.placeholder: Example: cold room not pulling down, HP alarm on a summer afternoon, Octosense controller…
home.empty: Ask about temperature, alarms, ice, compressors, ammonia, or controllers.
home.disclaimer: Guidance is taken from Cantek documents. It is not a substitute for a certified refrigeration technician. Follow local emergency rules first.

chat.noDocs: Nothing in the loaded manuals matches this. Contact Cantek service rather than guessing setpoints or wiring.
